improvements_proposed.title: DataJud API key: adopt env-var pattern with public fallback
improvements_proposed.scope: scraper/datajud.py line 15 — replace hardcoded string with os.environ.get("DATAJUD_API_KEY", "<current_public_key>")
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — aligns with best practice; allows override via env var; no behaviour change since key is public and fallback is retained
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: None technical — only PROPOSE_ONLY mode this cycle. Ready for APPLY_NOW in Cycle 002 with branch.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Even public API keys should be sourced from environment variables to allow override without code changes and to document that a configuration point exists. The TypeScript layer already uses this pattern (server/scraping/types.ts:113-114).

improvements_proposed.title: Add helmet middleware for HTTP security headers
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — add import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })) after express.urlencoded()
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — adds X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS headers automatically; prevents clickjacking and MIME sniffing with zero runtime overhead
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: npm install helmet. User approval needed before modifying package.json.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Express out-of-the-box sends no security headers. Helmet is the de-facto standard. CSP disabled initially to avoid breaking Vite-injected inline scripts; can be tightened per-route in a later cycle.

improvements_proposed.title: Add express-rate-limit on API endpoints — especially scraping routes
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — global limiter (100 req/min on /api/*) + tight limiter (10 req/min on /api/pesquisa/* and /api/consulta-processual)
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — prevents abuse of expensive DataJud/ScraperAPI calls, protects SCRAPER_API_KEY monthly quota, reduces cascading failure risk
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: npm install express-rate-limit. User approval needed.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Scraping endpoints invoke external paid APIs. Without rate limiting a single bot can exhaust the monthly ScraperAPI quota in minutes. The fix is ~15 lines of code.

improvements_proposed.title: Split server/routes.ts into domain-scoped route modules
improvements_proposed.scope: Create server/routes/ directory with: clientes.ts, equipe.ts, processos.ts, atividades.ts, documentos.ts, financeiro.ts, scraping.ts, dashboard.ts, acervo.ts, comunicacoes.ts, deadlines.ts. Keep server/routes.ts as thin re-exporting index.
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — improves maintainability, reduces merge conflicts, enables per-domain code ownership; zero behaviour change
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Large mechanical refactor (3609 lines). Must preserve exact endpoint signatures and middleware order. High blast radius. Recommend dedicated cycle or background task with full test coverage in place first.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Current single-file architecture with 125 endpoints makes navigation impractical, causes accidental cross-domain coupling, and creates high conflict risk in multi-agent development.

improvements_proposed.title: Add console.error logging to 3 silent catch(e) blocks
improvements_proposed.scope: server/routes.ts lines ~779, ~846, ~885 — add console.error('[context] JSON parse failed:', e) before each res.status(500).json()
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — makes JSON parse failures visible in logs; enables debugging of Python scraper response format issues
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: None technical — only PROPOSE_ONLY mode this cycle. Ready for APPLY_NOW in Cycle 002 with branch. Confidence 0.90.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Silent catch blocks that only return a 500 to the client hide the actual parse error from operators. When a Python scraper returns malformed JSON, there is currently zero trace in the server logs.

improvements_proposed.title: Clamp parseInt query params to prevent unbounded resource consumption
improvements_proposed.scope: server/routes.ts line 897 (?limit=) and line 2725 (?horas=) — wrap with Math.min(Math.max(1, parseInt(...) || default), max_value)
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — prevents a client from requesting arbitrarily large result sets or time windows; limit: clamp to 1-500; horas: clamp to 1-8760
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: None technical — only PROPOSE_ONLY mode this cycle. Ready for APPLY_NOW in Cycle 002 with branch. Confidence 0.80.
improvements_proposed.rationale: parseInt(req.query.limit) || 50 returns 50 when limit=0 (minor bug) and has no upper bound when limit=99999 (partial DoS risk on the database layer). A simple Math.min/Math.max clamp fixes both issues in one expression.

improvements_proposed.title: Configure vitest as test runner with initial route smoke-tests
improvements_proposed.scope: Install vitest + supertest; add vitest.config.ts; add server/routes.test.ts with GET /api/clientes, GET /api/processos, GET /api/equipe smoke tests
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — enables all future PROMETHEUS APPLY_WITH_NEW_TEST fixes; catches regressions; unblocks confidence-gated auto-apply of remaining findings
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires modifying package.json (add vitest, supertest, @vitest/coverage-v8). User approval needed. vitest.config.ts creation is allowed.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Without a test runner PROMETHEUS can only propose behavior-neutral fixes. A test runner would unlock APPLY_WITH_NEW_TEST lane and allow safe application of ~70% of currently deferred findings.

improvements_proposed.title: Add explicit CORS configuration with origin whitelist
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — currently low risk (SPA and API co-hosted); becomes critical if deployment topology separates frontend from API or if a mobile app is added
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing cors package OR manual implementation. Low priority while SPA and API share origin.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Explicit CORS documents intent and prevents accidental cross-origin access if deployment topology changes.

improvements_proposed.title: Adopt structured logging (pino) — replace 31 console.error calls
improvements_proposed.scope: Install pino + pino-pretty; create server/logger.ts; replace console.error/warn/log throughout server/ with logger.error/warn/info including {requestId, path, method} context
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — structured logs enable aggregation, request tracing, and faster debugging in production; pino is 5x faster than console.log
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing pino and pino-pretty. Broad change touching 31+ call sites across server/ directory.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Unstructured console.error in production is hard to filter, aggregate, or alert on. Structured logging is a prerequisite for observability tooling (Datadog, Loki, CloudWatch).
